editorial.jobs_exams: No routine recruitment, job or exam notices included
editorial.script_originality: PASS — original Hindi narration written from sourced facts with fresh structure and explanatory context
editorial.sensationalism: PASS — no rumours, communal/caste bait, misleading claims or graphic detail
editorial.story_mix: Four Western UP stories plus 15 seconds of West UP weather occupy 210 seconds; eight wider India/UP stories, all-India weather, opening and closing occupy 390 seconds.

research_verification.note: Two local reports corroborate all 55 passengers escaped; tyre-burst cause is attributed to the Chief Fire Officer and not stated as a final technical finding.
Statewide figures and local reports cross-checked; seizures and samples are not described as final lab-confirmed adulteration.
One local complaint report plus official cybercrime portal; no platform breach, recovery or perpetrator identity claimed.
₹100 crore is explicitly a trader estimate, not actual audited or official turnover.
September CPI figures are from official MoSPI/PIB release; weak soil moisture is framed as a supply risk, not guaranteed local price rise.
Damage figures are preliminary APSDMA estimates reported on 3–4 Nov; IMD's 4 Nov release confirms the system had weakened to a depression.
World Gold Council Q3 data and full-year outlook corroborated; full-year demand is a forecast.
₹14,500 crore/92 GWh scheme supported by PMO/Cabinet release and independent reports; no immediate household bill reduction claimed.
₹2,814 crore lithium/nickel processing support supported by PMO/Cabinet release and Reuters; planned plants are not represented as operating.
Advisory is directed at financial institutions; script does not claim every customer account is compromised.
DLS result and key score/performance facts corroborated by Reuters, Hindustan Times and Times of India.
Cabinet scheme extension and outlay supported by PMO and independent reports; 850 is planned capacity, not 850 newly operating courts.
IMD West UP page issued 5 Nov shows no warning 5–11 Nov; Moradabad/Bareilly city forecasts dated 4 Nov; current South India warning pages issued 5 Nov checked at 06:24 IST.

script_originality_review.details: 1288-word original Hindi narration written from the source dossier; no article or broadcaster copy/translation.

sensitive_content_review.details: Moradabad bus fire is described without panic footage or injury imagery. Sambhal cyber-fraud is a complaint, not an accusation against the platform. Disaster figures are labelled preliminary.
